## Booking/contact
- LINE booking link: https://line.me/ti/p/F2MWlK47xD
- Reservation is required
- Check-in and location details are provided after booking confirmation
- Optional availability reference page loads `data/calendar-basic.ics` (synced from Google Calendar); events mentioning 熱氣球 / 雲朵 / 露營車 are labeled for balloon tent, cloud tent, and campervan respectively. Not a substitute for LINE confirmation.

## Key facts
- Two independent dome tent areas (熱氣球房 / 雲朵房)
- Around 100 ping exclusive grass space per area
- Not a shared dense campsite; each area is independently used
- Supports glamping stay and campervan-related services
